title: Utility of Ultrasound Imaging Features in Diagnosis of Breast Cancer
authors: Alshoabi SA, Alareqi AA, Alhazmi FH et al.
why_relevant: Odds ratios of BI-RADS-type US features (irregular shape, non-circumscribed margin, distortion, skin thickening, nipple retraction, node enlargement) for a correct malignant US call; cohort is all-malignant, so not a benign-vs-malignant PPV study.

title: Breast imaging reporting and data system for sonography: Positive and negative predictive values of sonographic features in Kumasi, Ghana
authors: Badu-Peprah A, Otoo OK, Amamoo M et al.
why_relevant: Per-descriptor sensitivity/specificity/PPV/odds ratio for BI-RADS US descriptors and associated features including vascularity and skin changes (n=60, Ghana).

title: Breast Imaging Reporting and Data System v2025: Key Updates in US
authors: Chang JM, Ha SM, Yoen H
venue: Journal of the Korean Society of Radiology
why_relevant: Concise list of BI-RADS v2025 US lexicon changes: lobulated shape, mixed solid and cystic, posterior combined removed, non-mass lesions, micro/macrocalcifications, echogenic rind and pseudocapsule, lymph node criteria.

title: How Does ACR BI-RADS<sup>®</sup> v2025 Change the Radiologist's Approach? A Practical Guide Across Mammography, Ultrasound, and MRI: A Narrative Review
authors: Kaplan E, Aydemir AB
why_relevant: Side-by-side table of 2013 5th edition vs v2025 descriptors for US (and mammography/MRI) with rationale and reported diagnostic performance, incl. elastography.

title: Are Irregular Hypoechoic Breast Masses on Ultrasound Always Malignancies?: A Pictorial Essay
authors: Kim YR, Kim HS, Kim HW
why_relevant: Pictorial essay of benign lesions that look irregular and hypoechoic (fat necrosis, mastitis, scars, sclerosing adenosis, etc.): the false-positive side of suspicious descriptors.

title: Nonmass Lesions on Breast Ultrasound: Radiologic-Pathologic Correlation and a Practical Guide to Diagnostic Approach
authors: Kim H, Lee H, Choi JS
why_relevant: Non-mass lesion descriptors (distribution, echo pattern, associated calcification, duct change, shadowing, vascularity) with literature PPV ranges and a diagnostic approach.

title: BI-RADS v2025 for breast ultrasound: key updates and Asian perspectives
authors: Song H, Shu R, Uematsu T et al.
why_relevant: BI-RADS v2025 US key updates (glandular tissue component, non-mass lesion descriptors and malignancy rates, lymph node morphology) with Asian-practice perspective.

title: Non-mass lesions on breast ultrasound: why does not the ACR BI-RADS breast ultrasound lexicon add the terminology?
authors: Uematsu T
why_relevant: Definitions and categories of non-mass lesions on breast US (ductal/non-ductal hypoechoic areas, architectural distortion, multiple small cysts) and their malignancy relevance.

title: Validation of the fifth edition BI-RADS ultrasound lexicon with comparison of fourth and fifth edition diagnostic performance using video clips
authors: Yoon JH, Kim MJ, Lee HS et al.
why_relevant: Per-descriptor PPV table for every grayscale 5th-edition BI-RADS US descriptor (shape, orientation, margin, echo, posterior, calcification, associated), 4th vs 5th edition (n=80 masses).

title: Computer-aided assessment of tumor grade for breast cancer in ultrasound images
authors: Chen DR, Chien CL, Kuo YF
venue: Computational and mathematical methods in medicine
why_relevant: Textural, morphological, ellipsoid-fitting and posterior acoustic feature definitions (3D breast US) related to tumor grade.

title: Quantitative outperforms visual assessment of nonparallel orientation in ultrasound breast imaging reporting and data system
authors: Chen K, Chen Q, Wu S
why_relevant: Quantitative orientation angle of the mass long axis vs skin with a malignancy cut-off (>22.3 deg), compared with visual parallel/non-parallel assessment.

title: Breast Tumor Classification in Ultrasound Images Using Combined Deep and Handcrafted Features
authors: Daoud MI, Abdel-Rahman S, Bdair TM et al.
why_relevant: Lists 10+ handcrafted morphological features (form factor, roundness, aspect ratio, convexity, solidity, extent, undulation, compactness, NRL entropy/variance, ellipse-fit features) combined with deep features.

title: Performance of machine learning software to classify breast lesions using BI-RADS radiomic features on ultrasound images
authors: Fleury E, Marcomini K
why_relevant: Computable BI-RADS-mapped features (ADEE, orientation, NumPeaks, AvgDistance, convex hull area difference, echogenicity, entropy, posterior shadow, size) with formulas and ML AUCs.

title: Machine Learning in Ultrasound Computer-Aided Diagnostic Systems: A Survey
authors: Huang Q, Zhang F, Li X
why_relevant: Survey of US CAD features: GLCM texture, spiculation, depth-to-width ratio, elliptic-normalized circumference and skeleton, with definitions.

title: Observer Variability in BI-RADS Ultrasound Features and Its Influence on Computer-Aided Diagnosis of Breast Masses
authors: Sultan LR, Bouzghar G, Levenback BJ et al.
why_relevant: Inter-observation variability of BI-RADS US features and its effect on a Bayesian CAD probability of malignancy: how reliable descriptor-level inputs are.

title: A Benign and Malignant Breast Tumor Classification Method via Efficiently Combining Texture and Morphological Features on Ultrasound Images
authors: Wei M, Du Y, Wu X et al.
venue: Computational and mathematical methods in medicine
why_relevant: Defines compactness, elliptic compactness, radial distance spectrum and LBP/HOG/GLCM texture features for benign/malignant breast US classification.

title: Breast tumor segmentation and morphological feature-based classification in ultrasound using a two-stage U-net and SVM
authors: Ye Y, Ye M, Wang H et al.
why_relevant: Mask-derived circularity, solidity, eccentricity and extent with formulas and benign/malignant medians, aligned with BI-RADS shape/margin.

title: Classification of Benign and Malignant Breast Tumors in Ultrasound Images with Posterior Acoustic Shadowing Using Half-Contour Features
authors: Zhou Z, Wu S, Chang KJ et al.
venue: Journal of medical and biological engineering
why_relevant: Contour features (tumor circularity, normalized radial length mean/SD, area ratio, roughness index, SDD) and how posterior acoustic shadowing biases them.

title: Multi-Features-Based Automated Breast Tumor Diagnosis Using Ultrasound Image and Support Vector Machine
authors: Zhuang Z, Yang Z, Zhuang S et al.
why_relevant: Quantifies orientation, edge indistinctness, posterior shadowing (Hu moments) and shape complexity (fractal dimension) from segmented breast US lesions.

title: Image biomarker standardisation initiative (IBSI reference manual, v11)
authors: Zwanenburg A, Leger S, Vallieres M et al.
why_relevant: Reference definitions and benchmark values for radiomics features (morphology, intensity, histogram, GLCM, GLRLM, GLSZM, GLDZM, NGTDM, NGLDM) incl. 2D variants usable on a B-mode image + mask.

title: PyRadiomics documentation: Radiomic Features
authors: van Griethuysen JJM, Fedorov A, Parmar C et al. (PyRadiomics community)
why_relevant: Formulas and plain-language definitions of every PyRadiomics feature (first order, 2D/3D shape, GLCM, GLSZM, GLRLM, NGTDM, GLDM) the agent could request from a mask.

title: Artificial Intelligence in Breast Ultrasound: From Diagnosis to Prognosis-A Rapid Review
authors: Brunetti N, Calabrese M, Martinoli C et al.
why_relevant: Rapid review of AI in breast US from diagnosis to prognosis, covering CAD and deep learning feature use.

title: Ultrasound radiomics in personalized breast management: Current status and future prospects
authors: Gu J, Jiang T
why_relevant: Review of breast US radiomics workflow and feature families (shape, first/second/higher-order texture, peritumoral) for diagnosis, subtype, nodes, NAC response.

title: Ultrasound-based radiomics for the evaluation of breast cancer
authors: Sun FY, Meng DL, Liu L et al.
why_relevant: Recent review of US radiomics for breast cancer (morphological, texture, first-order, wavelet, intra- and peritumoral features) with reported AUCs.
